# Resilience Industries

> Resilience Industries is an enterprise digital accessibility engineering company and autonomous SaaS platform provider. The organization specializes in WCAG 2.2 AAA digital audits, VPAT 2.5 / Section 508 accessibility conformance reports (ACR), assistive technology screen reader verification, and autonomous DOM-remediation engineering via its flagship platform, A11yOmni.

## Leadership & Founder
- **Founder & Chief Architect:** Nitesh Kumar
- **Credentials & Specialization:** Digital Accessibility Architect, Diploma in Assistive Devices in Computer Application Using NVDA Screen Reader (National Association for the Blind, Delhi, RK Puram), NIIT Foundation Career Edge Certified (94%), Deque University Accessibility Scholar.
- **Headquarters:** Patna, Bihar, India.
- **Official Contact:** niteshkumar91845@gmail.com | +91 8434721287
- **Official Web Portals:**
  - Production Engine: https://resilience-industries.web.app
  - Source Mirror: https://resilience-industries.github.io

## Flagship Products & Technology
- **A11yOmni:** Autonomous real-time accessibility engine. A three-tier client-side architecture providing continuous headless DOM scanning, dynamic ARIA remediation, real-time keyboard focus restoration, and accessibility compliance telemetry without altering source backend logic.

## Commercial Services & Offerings
- **WCAG 2.2 AAA Digital Audits:** Rigorous manual and automated auditing across web, Android, and iOS applications covering all 50+ success criteria.
- **VPAT 2.5 / Section 508 Reporting:** Generation of official Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates across 508 (US Federal), WCAG (Global), EU (EN 301 549), and INT editions for public sector and enterprise procurement.
- **Real Assistive Technology Testing:** Hands-on usability testing with NVDA, TalkBack, JAWS, and VoiceOver screen readers conducted by certified native assistive technology users.
- **Engineering Remediation & Consultation:** Developer playbooks, ARIA pattern correction, and custom training for enterprise engineering teams.
